title: Zebra fixes focus on reliable synchronization
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
03
Zebra fixes focus on reliable synchronization
Engineering period: Aug 24-Sep 6 · Published Sep 9
ZCASH FOUNDATION
ZEBRA + ZALLET
01
Chain-tip recovery
Retries for blocks awaiting a parent address the recurring near-tip sync restart loop.
02
Operator efficiency
Bounded lookups, lower memory use and state-snapshot guidance improve node
operation.
03
Shared wallet work
ZF contributed cleaner retry and error handling to ZODL’s Zallet wallet.
04
Next networking layer
QUIC and chunked synchronization remain experimental and disabled by default.

text:

METHODOLOGY
34
How this partial-period edition is defined
September 1-10, 2026 · Frozen at the recorded capture times
01
Payments
Only paid grant installments dated Sep 1-10.
All 12 rows match the original sheet. USD and
ZEC are summed independently.
02
Percentages
Category shares use $218,450 paid in this
interval. No comparison with August or a
complete September is presented.
03
Newly published reports
A September publication may describe August
work. Both dates remain visible; earlier
activity is not counted as September delivery.
04
Governance context
The ongoing Q3 review and NU7 polls are
statuses at cutoff. Their earlier submissions
and future deadlines remain explicit.
05
Round arithmetic
The API’s large-request subtotal is $810 low.
Recomputed rows match FPF’s $8,036,992
subtotal and $9,014,383.20 total.
06
Treasury scope
Revalue Aug 5 holdings at the Sep 10 quote;
round accounts to cents, then sum. No new
balance or funds flow is inferred.
